8. Medical Ethics

Core principles: - Autonomy - Beneficence - Non-maleficence - Justice

Ethical dilemmas: - End-of-life care - Resource allocation - Informed
consent

------------------------------------------------------------------------

metadata.document_summary: This document outlines the core principles and ethical guidelines for medical professionals, focusing on patient care, informed consent, and bioethics. It aims to provide a framework for addressing ethical dilemmas in medical practice.
